caption: The drawing depicts two objects, each rendered in shades of black, gray, and white on a beige background. On the left, there is a lantern-like object with a rectangular body and a prominent circular floral pattern on its front face. The edges and handle of the object are shaded in dark gray to black, and the handle extends outward from the side. The right-hand object is another lantern, cylindrical in shape with a domed top and a large circular, convex glass or reflective surface on the front. The domed top features cutout decorative patterns and a ring handle looped through a plate at the very top. The lighting and shading create a three-dimensional effect for both objects, highlighting the contours, textural patterns, and slight reflections on the surfaces. Both objects are centrally positioned on the page, with space between them, and drawn with fine, detailed lines and smooth gradients of shadow and light.
title: Lantern
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
